plugins.name: qa-agent
plugins.description: Agentic QA assistant: requirements analysis into risk-ordered test plans, browser execution through playwright-cli commands with a saved page snapshot per step, API testing, structured bug reports, sprint ticket reviews, and Jira via a bundled REST client. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: qa-loop
plugins.description: The QA retest loop around qa-agent: what changed on a ticket since my last comment, open drafts and unrestored test data, a test-data ledger with a restore check, safe browser helpers (tab guard, yopmail OTP reader, toasts, waits), permission checks (preflight, endpoint matrix, compare), one results file rendered into both the report and the Jira draft with evidence guardrails, a decisions memory, and lint-checked Jira comments. Requires qa-agent. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: qa-annotate
plugins.description: Marks failing screenshots: a box or arrow with a numbered reason on the failing element, an Expected / Actual banner from the test record, and blur over personal data, in a separate marked copy. Requires qa-agent; draws through playwright-cli. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: git-agent
plugins.description: Drafts a commit message - title and description - from the current working-tree changes, matched to the repository's existing commit style. Presents the draft for review and never commits without an explicit go-ahead. No MCP servers.

plugins.name: pw-setup-agent
plugins.description: Sets up and maintains a Playwright + TypeScript test project at the repository root (merged safely into an existing app) or in a sub-folder, using page objects, fixtures and typed test data, and checks that the project follows the conventions and works. No MCP servers required.
